---
title: Token frequencies in Latin texts
---


## Overview

Choose a minimum number of occurrences to consider, and graph frequencies of tokens for each of the texts in the Complutensian Bible.

## Notebook

:::{.callout-warning title="Uses local resources"}
This notebook uses data in local files, and expects to be run files from a copy of [this github repository](https://github.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts).
:::

- [HTML version](./zipf.html) (readable in a web browser)
- [Pluto notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neelsmith/complutensian-texts/refs/heads/main/pluto/compare-texts/zipf.jl) (download and run in Pluto)
